outcome: Preterm obstetrical intervention (no labor cesarean or induction)
cohort: Singleton preterm births in the United States between 2014 and 2019
finding: The percentage of singleton preterm births where obstetrical intervention potentially impacted the gestational age at delivery increased from 47.6% in 2014 to 54.9% in 2019.
mod_finding: This study found an increase in preterm births delivered by cesarean section and induction of labor between 2014 and 2019 in the United States.
